### Age of maturity ~ gene copy variation
```{r}
 #age at 50% sexual maturity (years)
  brms_model_age_maturity<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(age_maturity=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,10]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(age_maturity=mean(age_maturity), .by = "sp")->fishbase_age_maturity
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_age_maturity) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=age_maturity))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=age_maturity))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->age_maturity_plots
    
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(age_maturity ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_age_maturity <- brm(age_maturity ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                age_maturity_plots=age_maturity_plots,
                model_brms_age_maturity=model_brms_age_maturity))
  }
  
  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_age_maturity)->model_age_maturity
  names(model_age_maturity)<-cafe_cols
  model_age_maturity %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_age_maturity.rds")

```

### Average temperature ~ gene copy number
Average temperature from portion of population sampled (celcius)
```{r}
 #average temperature from portion of population sampled (celcius)
  brms_model_temp<-function(col){
   library(brms)
   
   cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
   #lead the genecopy data
   orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                pull(genes))) %>% 
     filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
     dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
     pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
     replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
   #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
   
   expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
   scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
   pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
   pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
     rownames_to_column("sp")
   
   #Get this data from FishLife
   data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
   tibble(temperature=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,6]) %>%
     mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
     drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
     summarise(mean_temp=mean(temperature), .by = "sp")->fishbase_temperature_dat
   
   #join the datasets
   left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_temperature_dat) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
   
   #Prune the pglmm tree
   pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
   is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   #Must pass namecheck
   geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
   
   #plots to visualise response and predictors
   ggarrange(
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=mean_temp))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=mean_temp))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->temp_plots
   
   #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
   A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
   A<-A$Ainv
   #Priors
   priors<-get_prior(mean_temp ~  
                       PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                         data = model_dat,
                         data2   = list(A = A),
                         family = skew_normal())
   #Model
   model_brms_temp <- brm(mean_temp ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
     data = model_dat,
     data2   = list(A = A),
     prior = priors,
     family = skew_normal(),
     chains = 4, 
     cores = 4,
     iter = 5000, 
     warmup = 1000,
     backend = "cmdstanr",
     control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
   )
   
   
   return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
               temp_plots=temp_plots,
               model_brms_temp=model_brms_temp))
 }
```

### Trophic level ~ gene copy variation
 #trophic level (dimensionless), where 1 is primary producers, etc.
```{r}
 brms_model_trophic<-function(col){
   library(brms)
   
   cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
   #lead the genecopy data
   orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                pull(genes))) %>% 
     filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label & sp != "Danio_rerio") %>% 
     dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
     pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
     replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide

   expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
   scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
   pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
   pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
     rownames_to_column("sp")
   
   #Get this data from FishLife
   data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
   tibble(trophic_level=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,2]) %>%
     mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
     drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
     summarise(trophic_level=mean(trophic_level), .by = "sp")->fishbase_trophiclevel
   
   #join the datasets
   left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_trophiclevel) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
   
   #Prune the pglmm tree
   pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
   is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
   #Must pass namecheck
   geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
   
   #plots to visualise response and predictors
   ggarrange(
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=trophic_level))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     
     model_dat %>% 
       ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=trophic_level))+
       geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
       geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
       theme_linedraw(),
     nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->trophic_plots
   
   #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
   A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
   A<-A$Ainv
   #Priors
   priors<-get_prior(trophic_level ~  
                       PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                     data = model_dat,
                     data2   = list(A = A),
                     family = skew_normal())
   #Model
   model_brms_trophic <- brm(trophic_level ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
     data = model_dat,
     data2   = list(A = A),
     prior = priors,
     family = skew_normal(),
     chains = 4, 
     cores = 4,
     iter = 5000, 
     warmup = 1000,
     backend = "cmdstanr",
     control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
   )
   
   
   return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
               trophic_plots=trophic_plots,
               model_brms_trophic=model_brms_trophic))
 }

 names(model_trophic)<-cafe_cols
```

### Growth coefficient ~ gene copy variation
von Bertalannffy growth coefficient (year^-1)

```{r}
   brms_model_growthcoeff<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(growth_coefficient=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,5]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(growth_coefficient=mean(growth_coefficient), .by = "sp")->fishbase_growth_coefficient
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_growth_coefficient) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=growth_coefficient))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=growth_coefficient))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->growthcoeff_plots
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(growth_coefficient ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_growthcoeff <- brm(growth_coefficient ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                growthcoeff_plots=growthcoeff_plots,
                model_brms_growthcoeff=model_brms_growthcoeff))
  }
  
  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_growthcoeff)->model_growthcoeff
  names(model_growthcoeff)<-cafe_cols
  model_growthcoeff %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_growthcoeff.rds")
```

### Bodyshape ~ gene copy variation
Body shape categories
```{r}
 brms_model_bodyshape<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    rbind( 
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,26]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "elongated", 
                                    .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,27]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "short_and_or_deep", 
                                    .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,28]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "eellike", 
                                    .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(bodyshape=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,29]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & bodyshape==1) %>% 
        mutate(bodyshape= case_when(bodyshape==1 ~ "other", 
                                    .default = "other")))->fishbase_bodyshape_dat
    
    #join the datasets
    #Remove spare "other" category
    
    left_join(pca_gene,
              fishbase_bodyshape_dat %>% filter(bodyshape!="other")) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    model_dat %>% ggplot(aes(x=PC1.cpy, PC2.cpy))+
      geom_point(aes(fill=bodyshape), size=3, alpha=0.8, shape=21,
                 position = position_jitter(width = 2, height = 2))+
      scale_fill_bmj()+
      theme_linedraw()->bodyshape_plots
  
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(bodyshape ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy + (1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = categorical())
    #Model
    model_brms_bodyshape <- brm(bodyshape ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy + (1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = categorical(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                bodyshape_plots=bodyshape_plots,
                model_brms_bodyshape=model_brms_bodyshape))
  }

cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>%
  janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_bodyshape)->model_bodyshape
names(model_bodyshape)<-cafe_cols
model_bodyshape %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_bodyshape.rds")
```

### Habitat ~ gene copy variation
Demersal type for habitat category 
```{r}
  brms_model_habitat<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    rbind( 
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,20]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "bathymetric", 
                                  .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,21]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "benthopelagic", 
                                  .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,22]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "reefassociated", 
                                  .default = "other")),
      
      tibble(habitat=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,23]) %>%
        mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
        drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label & habitat==1) %>% 
        mutate(habitat= case_when(habitat==1 ~ "pelagic", 
                                  .default = "other")))->fishbase_habitat_dat
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_habitat_dat) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    model_dat %>% ggplot(aes(x=PC1.cpy, PC2.cpy))+
      geom_point(aes(fill=habitat), size=3, alpha=0.8, shape=21,
                 position = position_jitter(width = 2, height = 2))+
      scale_fill_bmj()+
      theme_linedraw()->habitat_plots
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(mvbind(PC1.cpy,PC2.cpy) ~  
                        habitat +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_habitat <- brm(
      mvbind(PC1.cpy,PC2.cpy) ~  
        habitat +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                habitat_plots=habitat_plots,
                model_brms_habitat=model_brms_habitat))
  }
  
  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_habitat)->model_habitat
  names(model_habitat)<-cafe_cols
  model_habitat %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_habitat.rds")
```

### Aspect ratio ~ gene copy variation
Caudal fin height and length divided by area (dimensionless)
```{r}


  brms_model_aspect_ratio<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(aspect_ratio=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,3]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(aspect_ratio=mean(aspect_ratio), .by = "sp")->fishbase_aspect_ratio
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_aspect_ratio) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=aspect_ratio))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=aspect_ratio))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->aspect_ratio_plots
    
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(aspect_ratio ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_aspect_ratio <- brm(
      aspect_ratio ~  
        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                aspect_ratio_plots=aspect_ratio_plots,
                model_brms_aspect_ratio=model_brms_aspect_ratio))
  }

  cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>% 
    janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_aspect_ratio)->model_aspect_ratio
  names(model_aspect_ratio)<-cafe_cols
  model_aspect_ratio %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_aspect_ratio.rds")
```

### Lower jaw length ~ gene copy variation
Length of lower jaw (cm)
```{r}
  brms_model_lower_jaw_length<-function(col){
    library(brms)
    
    cafe_genefamily_outs<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous")
    #lead the genecopy data
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod==col) %>% 
                                                 pull(genes))) %>% 
      filter(sp %in% pglmm_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% filter(sp %in% shapes_dat$sp)->sp_genes_wide
    #colnames(sp_genes_wide)<-c("sp", paste0("gene",seq(1:(ncol(sp_genes_wide)-1))))
    
    expr_scaled<-sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp")->pca_dat_gene
    scale(pca_dat_gene, center = FALSE,scale = TRUE)->pca_dat_gene
    pca_gene_pca <- phytools::phyl.pca(pglmm_tree, pca_dat_gene, method = "lambda", mode = "corr")
    pca_gene <- as.data.frame(pca_gene_pca$S) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.,".cpy")) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("sp")
    
    #Get this data from FishLife
    data(FishBase_and_Morphometrics)
    tibble(lower_jaw_length=FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij[,15]) %>%
      mutate(sp=(rownames(FishBase_and_Morphometrics$Y_ij) %>% str_replace_all(" ","_"))) %>%
      drop_na() %>% filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
      summarise(lower_jaw_length=mean(lower_jaw_length), .by = "sp")->fishbase_lower_jaw_length
    
    #join the datasets
    left_join(pca_gene,fishbase_lower_jaw_length) %>% drop_na()->model_dat
    
    #Prune the pglmm tree
    pglmm_tree_fishbase<-drop.tip(pglmm_tree,pglmm_tree$tip.label[-match(model_dat$sp, pglmm_tree$tip.label)])
    is.rooted(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    is.ultrametric(pglmm_tree_fishbase)
    #Must pass namecheck
    geiger::name.check(pglmm_tree_fishbase,model_dat %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))
    
    #plots to visualise response and predictors
    ggarrange(
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC1.cpy, x=lower_jaw_length))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      
      model_dat %>% 
        ggplot(aes(y=PC2.cpy, x=lower_jaw_length))+
        geom_point(shape=21, fill="#8BAE06", size=3)+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,colour = "#F0710F")+
        theme_linedraw(),
      nrow = 1, ncol = 2)->lower_jaw_length_plots
    
    
    #Phylogenetic covariance matrix
    A<-MCMCglmm::inverseA(pglmm_tree_fishbase,scale = TRUE,nodes = "TIPS")
    A<-A$Ainv
    #Priors
    priors<-get_prior(lower_jaw_length ~  
                        PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),  
                      data = model_dat,
                      data2   = list(A = A),
                      family = skew_normal())
    #Model
    model_brms_lower_jaw_length <- brm(lower_jaw_length ~ PC1.cpy + PC2.cpy +(1 |gr(sp, cov = A)),
      data = model_dat,
      data2   = list(A = A),
      prior = priors,
      family = skew_normal(),
      chains = 4, 
      cores = 4,
      iter = 5000, 
      warmup = 1000,
      backend = "cmdstanr",
      control = list(adapt_delta=0.999, max_treedepth = 12)
    )
    
    
    return(list(pca_gene_pca=pca_gene_pca,
                lower_jaw_length_plots=lower_jaw_length_plots,
                model_brms_lower_jaw_length=model_brms_lower_jaw_length))
  }

cafe_cols<-cafe_sig %>% filter(is_sig=="y" & mod_type=="Homologous") %>%
  janitor::get_dupes(mod) %>% distinct(mod) %>% pull(mod)
  purrr::map(cafe_cols, brms_model_lower_jaw_length)->model_lower_jaw_length
  names(model_lower_jaw_length)<-cafe_cols
  model_lower_jaw_length %>% saveRDS("./RDS/model_lower_jaw_length.rds")
```

## Functional characterisation of genes
Here I functionally characterise the high turnover genes to determine whether they can have an affect on the traits they have a relationship with. I do not focus on the unreliable ones because they are likely driven by outliers. 
The functional characterisation involved looking at which tissues the high turnover genes are expressed in, using data from Bgee. Then I look at expression of these genes at the single cell level during embryonic development in zebrafish, followed by contrasting the expression in post embryonic development. I then look for specificity of expression of the genes during metamorphosis in clownfish and grouper. Lastly, I analyse perturbation data of the modules of which the high tuernover genes are members of using the ZFIN database.  
Collectively, this section tells me whether the genes are expressed in the relevant cell and tissue types where we predicted an association with a particular phenotype, how they function during embryonic and post embryonic development, and whether there is any specificity in their activity during metamorphosis. 

### Load data for setup
```{r, include=FALSE}
read_csv("./08.ZFIN/Danio_biomart.csv")->Danio_biomart #Obtained from bioMart package
read_tsv("./08.ZFIN/phenoGeneCleanData_fish_2023.05.07.tsv")->pheno #Download from ZFIN
read_tsv("./08.ZFIN/ensembl_1_to_1_2025.08.26.txt")->zfin_ids #Download from ZFIN
zfin_ids$...5<-NULL
bgee_combined_long<-readRDS("./RDS/Bgee_combined_long.rds")
```

```{r}
danio_genes_modules_annot<-danio_genes_modules %>% filter(gene %in% homologous_genes$genes) %>% left_join(homologous_genes, by=c("gene"="genes")) %>% dplyr::select(gene, orths, mod) %>% left_join(module_annot, by="mod") %>% filter(gene %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod_type=="Homologous" & is_sig=="y") %>% pull(genes)))


umap_gene_exp<-function(stage,process) {  
  zhub_dat<-readRDS(paste0("../For_submission/Teleost_convergence/RDS/zhub_",stage,"_log.rds"))

  danio_nutrient<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Nutrient absorption") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_brush<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Brush border epithelium development") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_synapse1<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Synaptic signalling 1") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_synapse2<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Synaptic signalling 2") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_peroxi<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Peroxisome process") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_cellcylce<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Cell cycle process") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_resp<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Aerobic respiration") %>% pull(orths)))

                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_dna$`Gene name`, "DNA replication",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_immune$`Gene name`, "Immune system",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_nutrient$`Gene name`, "Nutrient absorption",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_brush$`Gene name`, "Brush border epithelium development",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_synapse1$`Gene name`, "Synaptic signalling 1",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_synapse2$`Gene name`, "Synaptic signalling 2",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_peroxi$`Gene name`, "Peroxisome process",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_cellcylce$`Gene name`, "Cell cycle process",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_resp$`Gene name`, "Aerobic respiration",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_neuron$`Gene name`, "Neuron migration and placode development",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_tranl1$`Gene name`, "Translation",

                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_protfold$`Gene name`, "Protein folding",
                                           "other")))))))))))))))))))))
  
  # UMAP colored by expression for all markers - plotReducedDim
  plot_list  <- lapply(rownames(zhub_dat)[rowData(zhub_dat)$marker_class == process], function(x){
    p <- plotReducedDim(zhub_dat, 
                        dimred = 'X_umap',

                        by_exprs_values = "logcounts",
                        point_size = 0.4)+
      scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "D",direction = -1)+
      xlab("UMAP1")+
      ylab("UMAP2")+
      labs(color = x)+
      theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank())
    return(p)
  })
  
  #Use this to make a single plot with all the genes
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list) %>% ggsave(filename = paste0("./09.Zhub/gene_UMAP_",stage,"_",process,".pdf"),device = "pdf",
                                                      width = 20, height = 15, units = "in", limitsize = F)
```

###### ZFIN data
There is not much genetic perturbation data for genes in the translation module. For the genes with available data I see that genetic perturbation tends to disrupt the embryo, decrease eye formation, affects trunk morphology, and influences swimming quality. pheno_alluvial(col = "black",freq_req = 1)

##### Immune system process 
Variation in gene copies in the Immune system module is linked with variation in maximum age and body shape.
High expression in different tissues due to distribution of sampling. However, the genes are typically expressed at high levels in spleen and head kidney, both of which are involved in the immune cell production. Furthermore, the expression of these immune genes in the pharyngeal gills potentially denotes the presence of gill-associated lymphoid tissues (GIALT) PMID: 32549335.

## Single cell expression and expression during metamorphosis

### Single-cell data

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(scuttle)

zhub_dat<-readRDS("./RDS/all_gene_24hpf.rds")
#Shows the cell types with the highest avaerage expression per module.
mod_plot_dat<-function(mod){
danio_genes_modules<-danio_genes_modules %>% 
  filter(gene %in% cafe_sig$genes) %>%
  left_join(cafe_sig, by=c("gene"="genes"))

mod_d<-danio_genes_modules %>% filter(module==mod)
#filter genes per module, them summarise the average expression of across cell types
zhub_dat %>% filter(gene %in% mod_d$orths) %>% 
  summarise(mean_logCounts=mean(logCounts), .by = c(zebrafish_anatomy_ontology_class, gene)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% mutate(module=mod)->plot_dat
return(plot_dat)
}

danio_genes_modules %>% filter(gene %in% homologous_genes$genes) %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module) %>% as.list()
cafe_sig<-cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(is_sig=="y")
purrr::map(danio_genes_modules %>% 
             filter(gene %in% cafe_sig$genes) %>%
             left_join(cafe_sig, by=c("gene"="genes")) %>% 
             distinct(module) %>% pull(module) %>% as.list(),
           mod_plot_dat) %>% list_rbind()->plot_dat_all


make_cell_dist_plots<-function(disc){
  plot_dat_all %>% left_join(danio_genes_modules %>% 
                               dplyr::select(-c(module,pval,is_sig)), 
                             by=c("gene"="orths")) %>% filter(annot==disc & gene.y %in% (danio_genes_modules %>%
                                                                                           filter(annot==disc))$gene) %>% mutate(module=reorder(module,mean_logCounts),                                                                                                                         zebrafish_anatomy_ontology_class=reorder(zebrafish_anatomy_ontology_class,mean_logCounts)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=zebrafish_anatomy_ontology_class, x=mean_logCounts, fill=mean_logCounts))+
    facet_wrap(~gene)+
    geom_col()+
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90",high = "#AE005E")+
    labs(title = paste0(disc),
         x="log2Counts",
         y="Cell type")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) %>% return()
}

purrr::map(cafe_sig %>% drop_na() %>%  distinct(annot) %>% pull(annot),make_cell_dist_plots)->make_cell_dist_plots_list
names(make_cell_dist_plots)<-as.character(cafe_sig %>% drop_na() %>%  distinct(annot) %>% pull(annot))
```
